# `get_callees_of`

Find all callees (downward call hierarchy) of an ABAP method, function module, or subroutine

Defined in [`packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/call-hierarchy.ts`](https://github.com/abapify/adt-cli/blob/main/packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/call-hierarchy.ts).

## Input schema

| Parameter     | Type     | Required         | Description                                                                                                    |
| ------------- | -------- | ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `baseUrl`     | `string` | no               | SAP system base URL (e.g. https://host:8000)                                                                   |
| `client`      | `string` | no               | SAP client number                                                                                              |
| `username`    | `string` | no               | Username for basic auth                                                                                        |
| `password`    | `string` | no               | Password for basic auth                                                                                        |
| `systemId`    | `string` | no               | Logical system id (resolved via the server multi-system configuration)                                         |
| `objectName`  | `string` | yes              | Name of the ABAP object (class, function group, program)                                                       |
| `objectType`  | `string` | no               | Object type (e.g. CLAS, FUGR, PROG)                                                                            |
| `maxResults`  | `number` | no               | Maximum number of results (default: 50)                                                                        |
| `destination` | `string` | destination mode | Required when the server runs in destination mode; an ADT destination key matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]\{1,62\}$`. |

_In destination mode every call additionally requires a `destination` key and rejects the connection fields (`baseUrl`, `client`, `username`, `password`, `systemId`)._

## Output

JSON object with shape `{ objectName, objectUri, callees }`. Returned inside `content[0].text`.

## Example invocation

```json
{
  "name": "get_callees_of",
  "arguments": {
    "baseUrl": "https://sap.example.com:44300",
    "username": "DEVELOPER",
    "password": "***",
    "client": "100",
    "objectName": "ZCL_MY_CLASS",
    "objectType": "CLAS"
  }
}
```

## Underlying contract

- `GET /sap/bc/adt/repository/informationsystem/callees` (via `client.fetch`)
